`preact-htm.js` is `htm/preact/standalone.module.js` from htm 3.1.1
(https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htm@3.1.1/preact/standalone.module.js): Preact 10 with its
hooks and htm in one ES module, so the interface needs no build step and loads nothing
from the internet.

- Preact: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2015-present Jason Miller
- htm: Apache License 2.0, Copyright 2018 Google Inc.

Kept exactly as downloaded. To update, download the same file from a newer htm release.
